---
title: "03_contrast_analysis"
output: html_document
---

Purpose: process the stage 1 contrast models (`02_contrast_modeling.qmd`, one model per species
and variant) into per-species summaries of the subadult - adult contrast and how consistent it
is across sites, years and events, check them against the unified model (m11g), and export the
contrasts for stage 2. Questions Q1-Q5 and definitions: `README.md`.

Scales used throughout:

- **prevalence part**: contrasts on the **logit prevalence** scale (= -logit(hu), the sign of the
  hu coefficients flipped), so a positive contrast means subadults are *more often infected*.
  Also shown as a difference in percentage points at a typical site and year.
- **load part**: differences in mu (mean log Bd load density among positive swabs). Positive =
  subadults carry *higher loads when infected*. Also shown as a fold difference (exp).
- Contrasts are compared within species only (labs differ in absolute levels).

What each summary means:

- **mean contrast** (Q1): the `stage_c` coefficient. stage_c = -0.5 / +0.5, so the coefficient is
  the full subadult - adult difference at a typical site, year and event.
- **contrast sd** per level (Q2-Q4): how much the contrast varies between sites, site-years
  (within sites) or events (within site-years). Only levels allowed by the species' tier have one.
- **contraction**: 1 - posterior variance / prior variance of a contrast sd. Near 1: the data
  pinned it down. Near 0: the posterior is still the prior (not informed; expected where few
  units are co-sampled). Used to fade out uninformed levels, not as a test.
- **sign consistency** per level: the probability that a new site (site-year, event) has a
  contrast with the same sign as the mean, = Phi(|mean| / sd), computed per draw. "all levels"
  combines every modeled level: a new event in a new year at a new site. It reads the sd on the
  scale of the mean: sd 0.4 around a mean of 1 is consistent, around a mean of 0.1 it is not.
- **variance shares** (Q5): sd^2 of a level / the sum over modeled levels. Comparable only between
  species with the same tier.
- **intercept-contrast correlation**: do sites (years, events) with more Bd overall have a larger
  contrast? Context for stage 2.
- **group contrasts**: each population's (site-year's, event's) contrast = mean + its deviations
  down the hierarchy. Groups where both stages were not co-sampled are shrunk toward their parent
  and are marked, so they are not read as observed contrasts.

Run order: `01_contrast_tiers.Rmd` (job table), cluster fits copied into
`size_bd_contrast/models/`, `02_contrast_modeling.qmd` (full model checks), then this script.
Optional comparisons read `size_bd_unified/intermediates/unified_03_b_spp_lss_draws.parquet`
(m11g) and `size_bd_season/intermediates/03_all_contrast_summary.csv` (seasonal models).

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| output: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show setup code"

# setup
librarian::shelf(tidyverse, here, brms, posterior, patchwork, arrow)

models_dir = here("size_bd_contrast", "models")
figures_dir = here("size_bd_contrast", "figures")
intermediates_dir = here("size_bd_contrast", "intermediates")
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# model data (brms_data), created by size_bd_unified/01_model_data.Rmd
load(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "bd_model_env_unified_2026-11-12.RData"))

# add_contrast_groups, co_unit_flags, constants
source(here("size_bd_contrast", "contrast_data_functions.R"))
# contrast_slope_groups, contrast_sd_prior_quantile
source(here("size_bd_contrast", "contrast_model_functions.R"))
# conv_check
source(here("size_bd_season", "season_check_functions.R"))
# f_draw_agg: median / 50% / 95% intervals, net effect, pd and support labels, so contrasts are
# reported in the same language as the unified analysis
source(here("size_bd_unified", "contrast_functions.R"))

```

# Jobs and fits
```{r}
contrast_jobs = read_csv(file.path(intermediates_dir, "01_contrast_jobs.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(job = paste(taxon_capture, variant, sep = "_"))

model_files = set_names(file.path(models_dir, paste0("size_bd_contrast_model_zln_c1_", contrast_jobs$job, ".rds")),
                        contrast_jobs$job)

missing_fits = names(model_files)[!file.exists(model_files)]
if (length(missing_fits) > 0) message("no fit yet: ", paste(missing_fits, collapse = ", "))
jobs_fit = contrast_jobs %>% filter(job %in% names(model_files)[file.exists(model_files)])

# phylogenetic order for plots and tables: tips of the pruned tree from the unified analysis, in
# plotting order after ladderizing (so sister species are adjacent). species not in the tree go
# last, alphabetically.
phylo_tree = ape::ladderize(ape::read.tree(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "phylo_tree.nwk")))
is_tip = phylo_tree$edge[, 2] <= ape::Ntip(phylo_tree)
tip_order = phylo_tree$tip.label[phylo_tree$edge[is_tip, 2]]
fit_species = unique(jobs_fit$taxon_capture)
species_order = c(intersect(tip_order, fit_species), sort(setdiff(fit_species, tip_order)))

species_label = function(taxon) str_to_sentence(gsub("_", " ", taxon))
species_levels = species_label(species_order)

# level names as used in the model and as shown in tables / plots
level_labels = c(population = "site", pop_year = "site-year", pop_year_event = "event", all = "all levels")

# the data each model saw, with grouping columns (to label group contrasts)
contrast_data = add_contrast_groups(brms_data) %>%
  filter(taxon_capture %in% fit_species)

```

# Process each fit
```{r}
# the fits are large (r. sierrae especially), so each is read, processed and dropped in turn:
# only summaries and a few numbers per draw are kept. the result is cached in intermediates/;
# set refresh = TRUE after replacing any fit (or when jobs change).
refresh = FALSE
results_file = file.path(intermediates_dir, "03_contrast_processed.rds")

# mean contrasts and contrast sds use all 8000 draws (cheap). group contrasts (one per site,
# site-year, event) use 2000 evenly spaced draws, plenty for summaries; 1000 of those are kept
# for the stage 2 draw export.
ndraws_group = 2000
ndraws_export = 1000

# column-wise summary of a draws x groups matrix of contrasts
summarise_cols = function(m) {
  q = apply(m, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.975))
  tibble(group_id = colnames(m),
         contrast_mean = colMeans(m),
         contrast_sd = apply(m, 2, sd),
         contrast_median = q[3, ],
         contrast_lower_50 = q[2, ],
         contrast_upper_50 = q[4, ],
         contrast_lower_95 = q[1, ],
         contrast_upper_95 = q[5, ],
         p_gt_0 = colMeans(m > 0))
}

process_contrast_fit = function(fit, job_row) {
  health = conv_check(fit) %>% mutate(job = job_row$job, .before = 1)

  # parts with a stage term: prefix of their parameter names, and the sign that turns the
  # coefficient into "subadult - adult, positive = subadults more infected"
  parts = tibble(part = c("prevalence", "load"),
                 pre = c("hu_", ""),
                 sign = c(-1, 1),
                 tier = c(job_row$tier_hu, job_row$tier_mu)) %>%
    filter(tier != "none")

  dr = as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^(b|sd|cor)_", regex = TRUE)
  n_draws = nrow(dr)
  ids_group = round(seq(1, n_draws, length.out = ndraws_group))
  ids_export = ids_group[round(seq(1, ndraws_group, length.out = ndraws_export))]

  # which population / site-year each event belongs to (ids are unique, so this is a lookup)
  units = fit$data %>%
    distinct(population, pop_year, pop_year_event) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.character))

  # group-level deviations of the contrast for one group and part: draws x levels matrix. ranef()
  # keeps the data's level names (some contain parentheses / apostrophes)
  re_contrast = function(group, pre) {
    re = ranef(fit, summary = FALSE, groups = group)[[group]]
    m = re[ids_group, , paste0(pre, "stage_c")]
    if (is.null(dim(m))) m = matrix(m, ncol = 1, dimnames = list(NULL, dimnames(re)[[2]]))
    m
  }

  per_part = pmap(parts, function(part, pre, sign, tier) {
    b = dr[[paste0("b_", pre, "stage_c")]]
    intercept = dr[[paste0("b_", pre, "Intercept")]]

    # mean contrast, plus the same on a readable scale at a typical site / year / event:
    #   prevalence: hu logit adult = intercept - 0.5 b, subadult = intercept + 0.5 b;
    #     prevalence = 1 - plogis(hu), so the difference (percentage points) is
    #     plogis(hu_adult) - plogis(hu_subadult)
    #   load: fold difference in load density among positives = exp(b)
    # computed before tibble(): inside tibble(), `part` would refer to the column just created
    typical_effect = if (part == "prevalence") {
      100 * (plogis(intercept - 0.5 * b) - plogis(intercept + 0.5 * b))
    } else exp(b)
    species_draws = tibble(job = job_row$job, part = part, .draw = seq_len(n_draws),
                           contrast = sign * b, typical_effect = typical_effect)

    # contrast sds, correlations and sign consistency per modeled level
    groups = contrast_slope_groups(tier)
    level_draws = map_dfr(groups, function(g) {
      tibble(job = job_row$job, part = part, level = g, .draw = seq_len(n_draws),
             sd = dr[[paste0("sd_", g, "__", pre, "stage_c")]],
             cor = dr[[paste0("cor_", g, "__", pre, "Intercept__", pre, "stage_c")]])
    }) %>%
      group_by(.draw) %>%
      mutate(share = sd^2 / sum(sd^2)) %>%
      ungroup()

    # "all levels": a new event in a new year at a new site, combining the modeled levels (levels
    # without a contrast slope in this tier count as 0)
    level_all = level_draws %>%
      group_by(job, part, .draw) %>%
      summarise(sd = sqrt(sum(sd^2)), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(level = "all", cor = NA_real_, share = NA_real_)

    level_draws = bind_rows(level_draws, level_all) %>%
      left_join(species_draws %>% select(.draw, contrast), by = ".draw") %>%
      mutate(sign_consistency = pnorm(abs(contrast) / sd)) %>%
      select(-contrast)

    # group contrasts (unsigned while building; sign applied at the end):
    #   site       = b + r_population
    #   site-year  = site + r_pop_year              (tiers A, B)
    #   event      = site-year + r_pop_year_event   (tier A)
    b_g = b[ids_group]
    m_pop = b_g + re_contrast("population", pre)   # b_g recycles down each column (one per draw)
    group_mats = list(population = m_pop)
    if ("pop_year" %in% groups) {
      r_py = re_contrast("pop_year", pre)
      pop_of_py = units$population[match(colnames(r_py), units$pop_year)]
      group_mats$pop_year = m_pop[, pop_of_py, drop = FALSE] + r_py
      colnames(group_mats$pop_year) = colnames(r_py)
    }
    if ("pop_year_event" %in% groups) {
      r_ev = re_contrast("pop_year_event", pre)
      py_of_ev = units$pop_year[match(colnames(r_ev), units$pop_year_event)]
      group_mats$pop_year_event = group_mats$pop_year[, py_of_ev, drop = FALSE] + r_ev
      colnames(group_mats$pop_year_event) = colnames(r_ev)
    }
    group_mats = map(group_mats, ~ sign * .x)

    group_summary = imap_dfr(group_mats, function(m, level) {
      summarise_cols(m) %>% mutate(level = level, .before = 1)
    }) %>%
      mutate(job = job_row$job, part = part, .before = 1)

    # stage 2 draw export: mean contrast, contrast sds and population contrasts, 1000 draws
    export_draws = bind_rows(
      species_draws %>%
        filter(.draw %in% ids_export) %>%
        transmute(job, part, quantity = "mean_contrast", level = NA_character_,
                  group_id = NA_character_, .draw, value = contrast),
      level_draws %>%
        filter(.draw %in% ids_export, level != "all") %>%
        transmute(job, part, quantity = "contrast_sd", level, group_id = NA_character_,
                  .draw, value = sd),
      as_tibble(group_mats$population[match(ids_export, ids_group), , drop = FALSE]) %>%
        mutate(.draw = ids_export) %>%
        pivot_longer(-.draw, names_to = "group_id", values_to = "value") %>%
        transmute(job = job_row$job, part = part, quantity = "group_contrast",
                  level = "population", group_id, .draw, value))

    list(species_draws = species_draws, level_draws = level_draws,
         group_summary = group_summary, export_draws = export_draws)
  })

  list(health = health,
       species_draws = map_dfr(per_part, "species_draws"),
       level_draws = map_dfr(per_part, "level_draws"),
       group_summary = map_dfr(per_part, "group_summary"),
       export_draws = map_dfr(per_part, "export_draws"))
}

if (!refresh && file.exists(results_file)) {
  processed = readRDS(results_file)
  if (!setequal(names(processed), jobs_fit$job)) {
    message("cached jobs differ from the fits available: set refresh = TRUE to reprocess")
  }
} else {
  processed = map(seq_len(nrow(jobs_fit)), function(k) {
    job_row = jobs_fit[k, ]
    message("processing ", job_row$job)
    fit = readRDS(model_files[[job_row$job]])
    out = process_contrast_fit(fit, job_row)
    rm(fit)
    gc()
    out
  })
  names(processed) = jobs_fit$job
  saveRDS(processed, results_file)
}

# stack each component across jobs
stack_component = function(name) map_dfr(processed, name)
fit_convergence = stack_component("health")
species_draws = stack_component("species_draws")
level_draws = stack_component("level_draws")
group_summary = stack_component("group_summary")
export_draws = stack_component("export_draws")

```

# Fit health
```{r}
# a compact flag carried with every result, so a problem fit is not read uncritically. the full
# checks (LOO, predictive checks, prior sensitivity) are in 02_contrast_modeling.qmd.
# thresholds as in conv_check (season_check_functions.R); a few divergences are tolerated.
fit_health = fit_convergence %>%
  mutate(fit_ok = max_rhat < 1.01 & min_ess_bulk > 400 & min_ess_tail > 400 &
           n_divergent <= 5 & min_ebfmi > 0.3) %>%
  left_join(jobs_fit %>% select(job, taxon_capture, variant, tier_hu, tier_mu), by = "job")

fit_health %>%
  select(job, tier_hu, tier_mu, n_obs, max_rhat, worst_rhat_par, min_ess_bulk, min_ess_tail,
         n_divergent, min_ebfmi, fit_ok) %>%
  arrange(fit_ok, desc(n_divergent))

```

# Summaries
```{r}
# job-level attributes carried with every summary
job_info = jobs_fit %>%
  select(job, taxon_capture, variant, tier_hu, tier_mu, n_adult, n_subadult,
         flag_time_segregated, flag_between_population) %>%
  left_join(fit_health %>% select(job, fit_ok), by = "job") %>%
  mutate(job_label = if_else(variant == "main", species_label(taxon_capture),
                             paste0(species_label(taxon_capture), " (", variant, ")")),
         flag = case_when(flag_between_population ~ "between-population",
                          flag_time_segregated ~ "time-segregated",
                          .default = "none"))

# ---- mean contrast (Q1) ----
contrast_agg = f_draw_agg(species_draws, c("job", "part"), "contrast")

typical_agg = species_draws %>%
  group_by(job, part) %>%
  summarise(typical_effect_median = median(typical_effect),
            typical_effect_lower_95 = quantile(typical_effect, 0.025),
            typical_effect_upper_95 = quantile(typical_effect, 0.975),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(typical_effect_unit = if_else(part == "prevalence", "percentage points", "fold"))

# ---- contrast sds, contraction, sign consistency, shares, correlations (Q2-Q5) ----
# exponential(2) prior on each contrast sd: variance 1 / rate^2 = 0.25
prior_sd_var = 1 / 2^2
# a level counts as "informed" when the data at least halve the prior variance of its sd.
# a reading aid for tables and fading in plots, not a test.
informed_contraction = 0.5

level_summary = level_draws %>%
  group_by(job, part, level) %>%
  summarise(sd_median = median(sd),
            sd_lower_95 = quantile(sd, 0.025),
            sd_upper_95 = quantile(sd, 0.975),
            contraction = if_else(first(level) == "all", NA_real_, 1 - var(sd) / prior_sd_var),
            sign_consistency_median = median(sign_consistency),
            sign_consistency_lower_95 = quantile(sign_consistency, 0.025),
            sign_consistency_upper_95 = quantile(sign_consistency, 0.975),
            share_median = median(share),
            cor_median = median(cor),
            cor_lower_95 = quantile(cor, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
            cor_upper_95 = quantile(cor, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(informed = contraction >= informed_contraction,
         level = factor(level, levels = names(level_labels)))

# ---- one row per job x part ----
species_summary = job_info %>%
  inner_join(contrast_agg, by = "job") %>%
  left_join(typical_agg, by = c("job", "part")) %>%
  mutate(tier = if_else(part == "prevalence", tier_hu, tier_mu)) %>%
  left_join(level_summary %>%
              select(job, part, level, sd_median, sd_lower_95, sd_upper_95, contraction,
                     sign_consistency_median, share_median, cor_median) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = level,
                          values_from = c(sd_median, sd_lower_95, sd_upper_95, contraction,
                                          sign_consistency_median, share_median, cor_median),
                          names_glue = "{level}_{.value}"),
            by = c("job", "part")) %>%
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x))))   # drops the share / cor / contraction columns of "all levels"

```

# Mean contrasts (Q1)
```{r}
#| fig-height: 9
#| fig-width: 11

# main fits only (the canorus sensitivity fit is in the consistency section). tier = how many
# levels the contrast may vary at; flags mark species whose contrast leans on comparing different
# populations or different times of year.
plot_main = species_summary %>%
  filter(variant == "main") %>%
  mutate(species = factor(species_label(taxon_capture), levels = rev(species_levels)),
         part = factor(part, levels = c("prevalence", "load")))

p_mean = ggplot(plot_main, aes(y = species, color = tier, shape = flag)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey60") +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = contrast_lower_95, xmax = contrast_upper_95), linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = contrast_lower_50, xmax = contrast_upper_50), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(aes(x = contrast_median, alpha = fit_ok), size = 2.2, fill = "white") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(none = 16, `between-population` = 21, `time-segregated` = 24)) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = 0.35), guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(A = "#1B9E77", B = "#D95F02", C = "#7570B3")) +
  facet_wrap(~ part, scales = "free_x",
             labeller = labeller(part = c(prevalence = "prevalence (logit)", load = "load among positives (log)"))) +
  labs(x = "subadult - adult contrast (median, 50 / 95% intervals)", y = NULL,
       subtitle = "positive = subadults higher; faded points = convergence flag") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"), legend.position = "bottom")

p_mean

# readable table: mean contrast, typical-site effect and support
fmt_ci = function(m, l, u, digits = 2) {
  sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f [%.", digits, "f, %.", digits, "f]"), m, l, u)
}

plot_main %>%
  arrange(part, species) %>%
  transmute(species, part, tier, flag, fit_ok,
            contrast = fmt_ci(contrast_median, contrast_lower_95, contrast_upper_95),
            typical_effect = paste(fmt_ci(typical_effect_median, typical_effect_lower_95,
                                          typical_effect_upper_95, 1), typical_effect_unit),
            pd = round(contrast_pd, 3), support = contrast_support)

```

# Contrast sds against the prior (Q2-Q4)
```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 12

# a posterior pulled toward 0 (inside the prior's lower range) = consistent contrast, or data
# can't tell (check contraction); a posterior away from 0 and narrower than the prior = real
# variation at that level. tier C species should mostly reflect the prior.
contrast_sd_prior = tibble(prior_median = contrast_sd_prior_quantile(0.5),
                           prior_upper_95 = contrast_sd_prior_quantile(0.95))

plot_sd = level_summary %>%
  filter(level != "all") %>%
  inner_join(job_info, by = "job") %>%
  filter(variant == "main") %>%
  mutate(species = factor(species_label(taxon_capture), levels = rev(species_levels)),
         tier = if_else(part == "prevalence", tier_hu, tier_mu),
         part = factor(part, levels = c("prevalence", "load")),
         level = factor(level_labels[as.character(level)], levels = level_labels))

p_sd = ggplot(plot_sd, aes(y = species, color = tier)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = contrast_sd_prior$prior_upper_95, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey93") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = contrast_sd_prior$prior_median, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(x = sd_median, xmin = sd_lower_95, xmax = sd_upper_95, alpha = informed),
                  size = 0.25) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = 0.35),
                     labels = c(`TRUE` = "informed", `FALSE` = "mostly prior"), name = NULL) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(A = "#1B9E77", B = "#D95F02", C = "#7570B3")) +
  facet_grid(part ~ level) +
  labs(x = "contrast sd (posterior median, 95% interval)", y = NULL,
       subtitle = paste0("grey band = prior 95% range; dashed = prior median; informed = contraction >= ",
                         informed_contraction)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 7), legend.position = "bottom")

p_sd

```

# Consistency profile (Q2-Q5)
```{r}
#| fig-height: 9
#| fig-width: 10

# one tile per species x level: fill = sign consistency (probability a new site / site-year /
# event keeps the sign of the mean contrast); faded = contrast sd mostly prior at that level;
# blank = level not modeled in this species' tier.
plot_profile = level_summary %>%
  inner_join(job_info %>% filter(variant == "main"), by = "job") %>%
  select(job, taxon_capture, part, level, sign_consistency_median, contraction) %>%
  complete(nesting(job, taxon_capture), part, level) %>%
  mutate(species = factor(species_label(taxon_capture), levels = rev(species_levels)),
         part = factor(part, levels = c("prevalence", "load")),
         level = factor(level_labels[as.character(level)], levels = level_labels),
         # "all levels" has no contraction of its own; show it solid
         tile_alpha = if_else(level == "all levels", 1, pmin(pmax(contraction, 0), 1)),
         label = if_else(is.na(sign_consistency_median), "",
                         sprintf("%.0f", 100 * sign_consistency_median)))

p_profile = ggplot(plot_profile, aes(x = level, y = species)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = sign_consistency_median, alpha = tile_alpha), color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 2.6) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F7F7F7", high = "#2166AC", limits = c(0.5, 1), na.value = "grey97",
                      name = "sign\nconsistency") +
  scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.25, 1), limits = c(0, 1), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ part) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       subtitle = "% of new units keeping the sign of the mean contrast; faded = contrast sd mostly prior") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"), panel.grid = element_blank())

p_profile

# variance shares among modeled levels (tier A species: where does the contrast vary most?)
level_summary %>%
  inner_join(job_info %>% filter(variant == "main"), by = "job") %>%
  filter(level != "all", if_else(part == "prevalence", tier_hu, tier_mu) == "A") %>%
  transmute(species = species_label(taxon_capture), part, level = level_labels[as.character(level)],
            share = round(share_median, 2), informed) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = level, values_from = c(share, informed))

# intercept-contrast correlations: positive = units with more Bd overall have a larger contrast
level_summary %>%
  filter(level != "all", informed) %>%
  inner_join(job_info %>% select(job, job_label), by = "job") %>%
  transmute(job_label, part, level = level_labels[as.character(level)],
            cor = fmt_ci(cor_median, cor_lower_95, cor_upper_95)) %>%
  arrange(part, level, job_label)

```

# Interpretation summary
```{r}
# one line per species x part: the mean contrast, which levels the data inform, the level where
# the contrast varies most (among informed levels), and the overall sign consistency
interpretation = species_summary %>%
  filter(variant == "main") %>%
  left_join(level_summary %>%
              filter(level != "all") %>%
              group_by(job, part) %>%
              summarise(informed_levels = paste(level_labels[as.character(level[informed])], collapse = ", "),
                        most_variable_level = if (any(informed)) {
                          level_labels[as.character(level[informed][which.max(sd_median[informed])])]
                        } else NA_character_,
                        .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("job", "part")) %>%
  mutate(species = factor(species_label(taxon_capture), levels = species_levels),
         informed_levels = na_if(informed_levels, "")) %>%
  arrange(part, species) %>%
  transmute(species, part, tier, flag, fit_ok,
            contrast = fmt_ci(contrast_median, contrast_lower_95, contrast_upper_95),
            support = contrast_support,
            informed_levels, most_variable_level,
            sign_consistency_all = round(all_sign_consistency_median, 2))

interpretation

```

# Group contrasts
```{r}
# labels for each group: swabs and positives per stage, co-sampled flags (for prevalence: co;
# for load: co_load), and for events the 14-day bin dates
unit_flags = imap_dfr(c(population = "population", pop_year = "pop_year", pop_year_event = "pop_year_event"),
                      function(unit, level) co_unit_flags(contrast_data, unit) %>% mutate(level = level))

event_info = contrast_data %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, pop_year_event) %>%
  summarise(population = first(population), year = first(year), event_bin = first(event_bin),
            median_date = median(date), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(bin_start = make_date(year, 1, 1) + days(event_bin * event_days),
         bin_end = bin_start + days(event_days - 1),
         bin_mid_doy = event_bin * event_days + event_days / 2)

popyear_info = contrast_data %>%
  distinct(taxon_capture, pop_year, population, year)

group_contrasts = group_summary %>%
  left_join(jobs_fit %>% select(job, taxon_capture, variant), by = "job") %>%
  left_join(unit_flags, by = c("taxon_capture", "level", "group_id" = "unit_id")) %>%
  mutate(co_sampled = if_else(part == "prevalence", co, co_load)) %>%
  left_join(popyear_info %>% rename(py_population = population, py_year = year),
            by = c("taxon_capture", "group_id" = "pop_year")) %>%
  left_join(event_info %>% rename(ev_population = population, ev_year = year),
            by = c("taxon_capture", "group_id" = "pop_year_event")) %>%
  mutate(population = case_when(level == "population" ~ group_id,
                                level == "pop_year" ~ py_population,
                                level == "pop_year_event" ~ ev_population),
         year = coalesce(py_year, ev_year)) %>%
  select(job, taxon_capture, variant, part, level, group_id, population, year, event_bin,
         bin_start, bin_end, bin_mid_doy, median_date, n_adult, n_subadult, n_pos_adult,
         n_pos_subadult, co_sampled, starts_with("contrast_"), p_gt_0)

# how many group contrasts rest on co-sampled units
group_contrasts %>%
  count(part, level, co_sampled)

```

## Population contrasts
```{r}
#| fig-height: 14
#| fig-width: 14

# one panel per species (main fits): each site's contrast, co-sampled sites solid. dashed line =
# the species mean contrast. non-co-sampled sites sit near the mean by construction (shrinkage).
plot_population_contrasts = function(part_name) {
  d = group_contrasts %>%
    filter(variant == "main", part == part_name, level == "population") %>%
    mutate(species = factor(species_label(taxon_capture), levels = species_levels)) %>%
    group_by(species) %>%
    mutate(population = fct_reorder(population, contrast_median)) %>%
    ungroup()
  means = plot_main %>%
    filter(part == part_name) %>%
    transmute(species = factor(as.character(species), levels = species_levels), contrast_median)

  ggplot(d, aes(x = contrast_median, y = population, alpha = co_sampled)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
    geom_vline(data = means, aes(xintercept = contrast_median), linetype = "dashed", color = "#2166AC") +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = contrast_lower_95, xmax = contrast_upper_95), size = 0.15) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = 0.3), name = "co-sampled") +
    facet_wrap(~ species, scales = "free", ncol = 6) +
    labs(x = paste0(part_name, " contrast (median, 95% interval)"), y = NULL) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 7), legend.position = "bottom")
}

p_pop_prev = plot_population_contrasts("prevalence")
p_pop_load = plot_population_contrasts("load")
p_pop_prev
p_pop_load

```

## Event contrasts through the season (tier A)
```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 14

# tier A species: each co-sampled event's contrast against time of year, on each species' own
# seasonal calendar (starting at the middle of its longest sampling gap, from
# size_bd_season/01_season_screen.Rmd, so seasons crossing the new year stay continuous). colored
# by year. grey band = species mean contrast (95%). events not co-sampled are omitted: their
# contrast is the site-year contrast plus shrinkage, not an observation.
season_origins = read_csv(here("size_bd_season", "intermediates", "01_season_species_all.csv"),
                          show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(taxon_capture, origin_doy)

month_start_doy = yday(make_date(2001, 1:12, 1))

plot_event_species = function(d, mean_row, origin) {
  d = d %>% mutate(season_day = (bin_mid_doy - origin) %% 365)
  ggplot(d, aes(x = season_day, y = contrast_median, color = factor(year))) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = mean_row$contrast_lower_95,
             ymax = mean_row$contrast_upper_95, fill = "grey90") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60") +
    geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = contrast_lower_95, ymax = contrast_upper_95), size = 0.15,
                    position = position_dodge(width = 4)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = (month_start_doy - origin) %% 365, labels = month.abb,
                       limits = c(0, 365)) +
    labs(title = species_label(mean_row$taxon_capture), x = NULL, y = NULL, color = "year") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "italic", size = 9),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6), legend.position = "none")
}

plot_event_contrasts = function(part_name) {
  tier_col = if (part_name == "prevalence") "tier_hu" else "tier_mu"
  tier_a = jobs_fit %>% filter(variant == "main", .data[[tier_col]] == "A")
  if (nrow(tier_a) == 0) return(NULL)   # no tier A species for this part
  plots = map(tier_a$taxon_capture, function(sp) {
    d = group_contrasts %>%
      filter(taxon_capture == sp, variant == "main", part == part_name,
             level == "pop_year_event", co_sampled)
    origin = coalesce(season_origins$origin_doy[season_origins$taxon_capture == sp][1], 1)
    mean_row = species_summary %>% filter(taxon_capture == sp, variant == "main", part == part_name)
    plot_event_species(d, mean_row, origin)
  })
  wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 4) +
    plot_annotation(subtitle = paste0(part_name, " contrast of co-sampled events (median, 95%) by time of year; ",
                                      "color = year; grey band = species mean (95%)"))
}

p_event_prev = plot_event_contrasts("prevalence")
p_event_load = plot_event_contrasts("load")
p_event_prev
p_event_load
```

## Site-year contrasts across years (tiers A and B)
```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 14

# does the contrast drift or swing between years? co-sampled site-years only, one panel per
# species; grey band = species mean contrast (95%)
plot_year_contrasts = function(part_name) {
  tier_col = if (part_name == "prevalence") "tier_hu" else "tier_mu"
  species_ab = jobs_fit %>% filter(variant == "main", .data[[tier_col]] %in% c("A", "B")) %>% pull(taxon_capture)
  if (length(species_ab) == 0) return(NULL)   # no tier A / B species for this part
  d = group_contrasts %>%
    filter(taxon_capture %in% species_ab, variant == "main", part == part_name,
           level == "pop_year", co_sampled) %>%
    mutate(species = factor(species_label(taxon_capture), levels = species_levels))
  means = species_summary %>%
    filter(taxon_capture %in% species_ab, variant == "main", part == part_name) %>%
    mutate(species = factor(species_label(taxon_capture), levels = species_levels))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = year, y = contrast_median)) +
    geom_rect(data = means, aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = contrast_lower_95, ymax = contrast_upper_95),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey90") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60") +
    geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = contrast_lower_95, ymax = contrast_upper_95), size = 0.15,
                    position = position_dodge2(width = 0.5)) +
    facet_wrap(~ species, scales = "free", ncol = 5) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = paste0(part_name, " contrast"),
         subtitle = "co-sampled site-years (median, 95%); grey band = species mean (95%)") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 8))
}

p_year_prev = plot_year_contrasts("prevalence")
p_year_load = plot_year_contrasts("load")
p_year_prev
```

# Consistency checks

## Against the unified model (m11g)
```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 10

# m11g species x stage linear predictors (hu logit, mu) at each species' median subadult weather,
# from 03_size_bd_unified_analysis.qmd. the contrast does not depend on the weather values (weather
# slopes do not vary by stage). differences are expected: m11g pools species, includes weather and
# climate zones, and has no event level; the question is whether the two agree in sign and rough
# size. load contrasts only for jobs with a load stage term (m11g's would rest on the prior).
m11g_draws = read_parquet(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "unified_03_b_spp_lss_draws.parquet"))

m11g_contrast = m11g_draws %>%
  select(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple, .draw, hu, mu) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = life_stage_simple, values_from = c(hu, mu)) %>%
  transmute(taxon_capture, .draw,
            prevalence = -(hu_subadult - hu_adult),
            load = mu_subadult - mu_adult) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(prevalence, load), names_to = "part", values_to = "m11g")

m11g_agg = f_draw_agg(m11g_contrast, c("taxon_capture", "part"), "m11g")

consistency_m11g = species_summary %>%
  filter(variant == "main") %>%
  select(taxon_capture, part, tier, fit_ok, contrast_median, contrast_lower_95, contrast_upper_95,
         contrast_support) %>%
  inner_join(m11g_agg %>% select(taxon_capture, part, m11g_median, m11g_lower_95, m11g_upper_95, m11g_support),
             by = c("taxon_capture", "part")) %>%
  mutate(same_sign = sign(contrast_median) == sign(m11g_median),
         part = factor(part, levels = c("prevalence", "load")))

p_consistency_m11g = ggplot(consistency_m11g, aes(x = m11g_median, y = contrast_median, color = tier)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "grey60", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey85") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey85") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = contrast_lower_95, ymax = contrast_upper_95), width = 0, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = m11g_lower_95, xmax = m11g_upper_95), width = 0, alpha = 0.5, orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(aes(alpha = fit_ok), size = 2) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = 0.35), guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(A = "#1B9E77", B = "#D95F02", C = "#7570B3")) +
  facet_wrap(~ part, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "m11g contrast (median, 95%)", y = "contrast model (median, 95%)",
       subtitle = "dashed = 1:1") +
  theme_classic()

p_consistency_m11g

# disagreements in sign, or support in one model only
consistency_m11g %>%
  filter(!same_sign | contrast_support != m11g_support) %>%
  transmute(species = species_label(taxon_capture), part, tier,
            contrast = fmt_ci(contrast_median, contrast_lower_95, contrast_upper_95), contrast_support,
            m11g = fmt_ci(m11g_median, m11g_lower_95, m11g_upper_95), m11g_support)

```

```{r}
# does giving canorus the full tier A structure change its mean contrast, or its site-level

canorus_jobs = jobs_fit %>% filter(taxon_capture == "anaxyrus_canorus") %>% pull(job)

species_summary %>%

level_summary %>%
  filter(job %in% canorus_jobs) %>%
  left_join(jobs_fit %>% select(job, variant), by = "job") %>%
  transmute(variant, part, level = level_labels[as.character(level)],
            sd = fmt_ci(sd_median, sd_lower_95, sd_upper_95),
            contraction = round(contraction, 2),
            sign_consistency = round(sign_consistency_median, 2)) %>%
```

## Against the seasonal models (optional)
```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 10

# the seasonal models' window-mean contrast (the average subadult - adult difference over the
# co-sampled part of the season, or the sampled window) against this mean contrast. same scales.
# only where both fits passed the convergence flag. skipped if 03_season_all_species_analysis.Rmd
# has not been run.
season_file = here("size_bd_season", "intermediates", "03_all_contrast_summary.csv")

if (file.exists(season_file)) {
  consistency_season = read_csv(season_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(fit_ok) %>%
    transmute(taxon_capture, part = metric, window,
              season_median = window_mean_median, season_lower_95 = window_mean_lower_95,
              season_upper_95 = window_mean_upper_95) %>%
    inner_join(species_summary %>%
                 filter(variant == "main", fit_ok) %>%
                 select(taxon_capture, part, tier, contrast_median, contrast_lower_95, contrast_upper_95),
               by = c("taxon_capture", "part")) %>%
    mutate(part = factor(part, levels = c("prevalence", "load")))

  p_consistency_season = ggplot(consistency_season, aes(x = season_median, y = contrast_median, color = tier)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "grey60", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = contrast_lower_95, ymax = contrast_upper_95), width = 0, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = season_lower_95, xmax = season_upper_95), width = 0, alpha = 0.5, orientation = "y") +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(A = "#1B9E77", B = "#D95F02", C = "#7570B3")) +
    facet_wrap(~ part, scales = "free") +
    labs(x = "seasonal model window-mean contrast (median, 95%)", y = "contrast model (median, 95%)",
         subtitle = "species where both fits converged; dashed = 1:1") +
    theme_classic()
  p_consistency_season
} else {
  consistency_season = NULL
  p_consistency_season = NULL
  message("no seasonal summary found (", season_file, "): skipped")
}
```
